name: eval-harness T3 skill — automated Achiri conversation quality scorer
goal: Implement agents/achiri/eval-harness.ts — pattern-based quality evaluator for Achiri conversations. Scores responses on warmth, cultural accuracy, code-switching, length appropriateness. No LLM needed. Used to benchmark personality before alpha and track kill switch threshold (retention >20%).
rationale: Achiri kill switch: retention <20% after 2 fixes → stop. Without automated quality scoring, quality regression is invisible. eval-harness enables CI-level personality testing before alpha launch (Apr 25).
swarm: NOT USED — new file only, direct write.

tasks.title: agents/achiri/eval-harness.ts — conversation quality evaluator
tasks.description: Export evalResponse(userMessage: string, achiriReply: string, context?: EvalContext): EvalResult. EvalResult = { score: number (0-100), breakdown: { warmth, cultural, code_switch, length, safety }, flags: string[], passed: boolean (score>=70) }. Scoring: warmth (greetings/Darija markers 0-25), cultural_accuracy (tunisian keywords 0-25), code_switch (Darija+French mix 0-20), length (50-300 chars optimal 0-20), safety (no harmful content pass/fail 0-10). Export also batchEval(pairs: Array<{user, reply}>) returning aggregate stats.

tasks.title: scripts/achiri/validate-eval-harness.ts — 5-check validation
tasks.description: Tests: (1) ideal Darija response scores >=70 (passed=true), (2) empty/short response scores <70, (3) English-only response scores lower than Darija response, (4) batchEval aggregates correctly, (5) response with tunisian cultural markers scores higher than generic response.
